# Ombreathe

> Ombreathe - Authentic Yoga Teacher Training, Retreats & Holistic Wellness Programs

## Overview

Ombreathe offers yoga teacher training programs (100hr, 200hr, 300hr, 500hr), yoga retreats, wellness programs, and Ayurveda healing across multiple locations.

## Programs

- [Yoga Teacher Training - Bali](https://ombreathe-new-vite.vercel.app/programs/bali/200hr)
- [Yoga Teacher Training - Rishikesh](https://ombreathe-new-vite.vercel.app/programs/rishikesh/200hr)
- [Yoga Teacher Training - Dharamshala](https://ombreathe-new-vite.vercel.app/programs/dharamshala/200hr)
- [Yoga Teacher Training - Chiang Mai](https://ombreathe-new-vite.vercel.app/programs/chiang-mai/200hr)
- [Yoga Retreats](https://ombreathe-new-vite.vercel.app/programs)
- [Online Yoga Programs](https://ombreathe-new-vite.vercel.app/online/200hr)
- [Membership Programs](https://ombreathe-new-vite.vercel.app/programs/shiv-shakti-sadhana)
